name: Kajiura Kouki
source:
A middle manager working for a trading company. Due to his work, he didn't have much opportunity to have a child. But when it comes the time to trying to have one, he realizes that his thing doesn't react at all.

[Translated and edited from the [url=http://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc076/character.html#kouki]Official website[/url]]
